title: Protect near-threshold REST and widget entrypoints
description: Audit near-threshold REST and widget entrypoint files before adding new save/load or render behavior.
objective: Prevent files just under 400 lines from becoming the next oversized surfaces during future feature work.
expected_outputs: Decision whether to split before new behavior
Follow-up task if either file crosses review budget
acceptance_criteria: REST route names and response shapes remain unchanged.
No new behavior is added during the audit.
Any future expansion above 400 lines opens a split task first.
verification: PHP lint passes if code is touched.
REST smoke check is queued if endpoint behavior is touched.

budgets.context_budget: REST endpoint and widget render entrypoint

risks: REST and render entrypoints can look small while hiding too many responsibilities.
Splitting too early can add ceremony if no new behavior is planned.
Waiting too long can recreate the current monolith problem.
